rv.q: Tim Rice and Andrew Lloyd Webber's rock opera still possesses extraordinary theatrical energy, and in Sam Ryder, it has found a leading man capable of carrying that legacy forward.
Though it isn’t anywhere near so bad that you could say the show has been crucified, it’s fair to say this version of Jesus Christ Superstar doesn’t quite manage to exceed expectations.

cn.t: This revival of the Andrew Lloyd Webber classic receives a mixed reception, with critics finding it doesn't quite reach the heights of recent West End successes like last year's acclaimed Evita at the same venue.
